notes.title: Steam's Spring Sale has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38528600/aa5e29b193f93997ac746cf9e12daee587795fb0.png[/img]

[h1][b]Steam's Spring Sale has arrived[/b][/h1], bringing unprecedented discounts! This spring, players around the world can dive into digital adventures and experience thrilling moments with their favorite games – all made possible by incredible discounts of up to 80% and beyond.

We aim to offer everyone the chance to experience something new and exciting, which is why we have selected a diverse range of games to suit every taste. Whether you are a passionate fan of strategy games, a master of fast-paced action games, or deeply immerse yourself in story-driven adventures, you are sure to find something that fascinates you.

But don't let these titles limit your exploration – Steam offers thousands of games from every possible genre, providing endless entertainment and new experiences. This is your opportunity to build your dream game library or discover the next great game that takes you on entirely new adventures.

The Spring Sale is not only a fantastic opportunity to save on your favorite games but also a chance to support and experience the creations of indie developers who bring fresh ideas and innovative gameplay mechanics to the market. Whether your game budget is big or small, Steam's Spring Sale has something for everyone.

Remember, these incredible offers are only available for a limited time, until 3-21. So, don't miss your chance – dive into Steam's world of games and start your adventure today!

Best regards

TAIVAS development

notes.title: TAIVAS storepage released on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38528600/5e85c8870226ef71b1fb3ef512c0ae317e8f9afe.png[/img]

[h1]TAIVAS on Steam[/h1]

Our store page is live now and new trailer uploaded, you are welcome to take a look!

[i]Taivas is a mysterious action roguelite, Dead Cells, rogue-lite, metroidvania inspired. set in a world of myth, and a time of magic. The destiny of a Canidae Kingdom rests on the shoulders of a young fox alike boy. His name… Joakim.[/i]

Use spells and special powers and weapons to explore, destroy and fight your way to the surface, the UpWorld, and even beyond... Sky will not be the limit on this marvelous adventure.

[h2]Story:[/h2]

You are Joakim, a young fox alike boy with fluffy tail and large, pointed ears, Knight of the Kingdom of Canidae. Kingdom has lived in peace for a long, long time, but now all kind of creatures are attacking against the Kingdom. Advisor to the Monarchy, magician Mikio sends you to a dangerous travel to the UpWorld. You start your journey from a middle of the Earth and start your journey to the surface, and beyond...

[h3]Special playing style[/h3]

The style of play of the game is different from the mainstream: you progress from the bottom up.

[h3]Features:[/h3]

Game currently offers one quite small but fun level! (cave)Save & Load function
[list]
[*] 1 Boss
[*] 1 Skill
[*] 0 special powers
[*] This First version offers 15-30 minutes fun
[/list]

Game is in development, and there will be a lots of improvements to the current character, new enemies and of course new levels.

Thank you for reading!

Best regards
[b]TAIVAS development[/b]
